invariant_patterns.brief: A unique constraint on (sku, location) guarantees no two rows share the same SKU+location pair; a second write to an existing pair cannot create a duplicate row.
sku, location, quantity, and inventory_code are NOT NULL; a stock record cannot be persisted without a SKU, a location, a quantity, and its combined tracking code.
CHECK (quantity >= 0) rejects any write that would store a negative stock level; no negative quantity is ever persisted.

The initial create_table migration for stock_records is reversible: a single-step downgrade-then-upgrade recreates the table with its columns and the (sku, location) unique + quantity CHECK constraints. This is schema recreation, not row survival (an initial create has no pre-existing rows to preserve).
